# Hanover Heating & Cooling

> Hanover Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Hanover, Grey County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 364-0182  |  Email: contact@hanoverheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://hanoverheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Hanover, Walkerton, Durham, Chesley, Ayton, Neustadt
